nodes.label: It Takes Two to Match: Co-Evolving Generative Retriever (CoGR)
nodes.author: Runpeng Dai; Kaili Huang; Changsung Kang; Ciya Liao
nodes.rationale: Rather than training only the query side against a frozen retriever, both query- and item-side keyword generators co-adapt against each other while staying compatible with existing inverted-index infrastructure.

nodes.label: Counterfactual marginal item-side reward
nodes.rationale: Swapping only one item's keywords into an otherwise-frozen index and measuring the resulting change in aggregate query-side F1 isolates that item's causal contribution and is cheap since unaffected queries drop out.
